answer: Prayers & Duties >> Waqf, Mosque, Madrasa Question ID: 44515 Country: India Title: Rebuild a mosque with basement parking. Question: There is an old mosque built in 1914 almost a century ago. We want to rebuild the mosque with various modern facilities. One being much needed parking. Can we build a basement or a stilt parking? Is it allowed to have a parking underneath the mosque? Please let me know. I also tried searching for related/matching questions but couldn't get any. Answer ID: 44515 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 529/409/D=1434) The land of the mosque which was fixed for offering salah it will be ruled as mosque from the earth to the sky. It is necessary to maintain the etiquettes of mosque in each floor of it. Hence it is not lawful to construct car parking under the portion in old mosque which was Shariah mosque (fixed for offering salah) or whatsoever portion is to be included in the mosque at the time of expansion. قال فى الدر لانه مسجد إلى عنان السماء قال الشامي وكذا إلى تحت الثرى (ج 1 ص 485 شامى) Yes, the car parking may be constructed below the portion which was declared out of the Shariah mosque at the time of waqf i.e. wudhukhana, etc. Also it is allowable if any new land is obtained for the mosque and car parking is constructed below it and other needs of the mosque i.e. room for Imam, etc are constructed above it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
